verses.text: In the 1611 KJV: yͤ = the. (See 1 John 1:1 for more.)

Sr. Benedicta Ward S.L.G., when she translated the Sayings of the Desert Fathers, attributed one saying by Abba Anthony to this verse in 1 John 4:18. Unfortunately, her typesetter missed the number 1, thus accidentally misattributing the saying to John 4:18 instead, a mistake that carried on from 1975 through MacMillan Publishing Co. to at least 1980.
